stories.title: RSPCA needs north Wales volunteers as gull rescues pile up this summer
stories.summary: Five orphaned herring gull chicks found near Prestatyn have been taken in by an RSPCA wildlife centre, as the charity appeals for more volunteer drivers across north Wales. stories.title: North Wales Police warns of rise in accidental 999 calls from car SOS buttons
stories.summary: North Wales Police is urging motorists to learn how their vehicle’s built-in emergency call system works, after a rise in accidental 999 calls. stories.title: Coleg Cambria learners hear water safety message from mother who lost son
stories.summary: A powerful and emotional water safety presentation left a lasting impression on learners after campaigner Debbie Anne Turnbull MBE shared the story behind her mission to save lives. More than 75 staff and students attended the session at Coleg Cambria’s Yale site in Wrexham, where Debbie spoke about the tragic loss of her son Chris

stories.title: Nine in ten adults in Wales don’t know how much water they use, survey finds
stories.summary: Nine in ten adults in Wales don’t know how much water they really use, according to a new survey. The average person believes they use around 30 litres of water a day, when the true figure is closer to 140. stories.title: Flint coastguards hit by ruling that strips emergency callout payments from volunteers
stories.summary: Coastguards from across the UK are set to gather in Westminster today, Wednesday, July 1, to demand the reinstatement of emergency callout payments cut following a court ruling.
